description: Barrier-shift pricing rules for autocallable products. Values are in barrier units (1.0 = 100% of the initial spot): 'relative' scales the original barrier level by (1 + value), 'additive' adds value to it. 'stepwise' keeps accruing value/periods per observation up to the full value at the last observation, clamped to [floor, cap] on the accumulated shift; 'step_offset' leaves that many leading observations unshifted. A contract may override the rule or the value (AutocallContract.shift_override); the CLI sits on top of both. Structure mirrors edslib apps/ODTS/indexo_barrier_shift_config.json (effective-date blocks + gap tiers + shift floor) plus the legacy GeneralBarrierShift defaults (-coupon/10 for KO; index-like relative -1.25%, else additive -3% for KI).
